references.text: Here is described the action where Zimri brought the Midianite woman to the camp, which led to him being killed by Phinehas.
The verse describes how the Israelite (Zimri) was pierced together with the Midianite woman by Phinehas.
The tribe of Simeon is mentioned here, and Zimri was a leader from the tribe of Simeon (a head of a clan among the Simeonites).
The clans of the Simeonites are counted in the second census, which took place after the plague that struck Israel because of the sin at Peor.
The sons of Simeon are listed, who are Zimri's ancestors and the background for his clan affiliation.
